description: Hall parameter correction, T-dependent conductivity, stagnation-enthalpy Q_in, optimal load factor

unit.name: Open-cycle Faraday MHD generator (K2CO3-seeded combustion plasma, superconducting magnet)
unit.source: Rosa (1987) Magnetohydrodynamic Energy Conversion; Messerle (1995) MHD Electrical Power Generation; Miura & Mori (1985) AIAA J.

sigma_plasma_0.note: Reference plasma conductivity at T_ref (seeded combustion ~5-50 S/m)

T_ref_K.note: Reference plasma temperature for conductivity model

sigma_T_exp.note: Conductivity temperature exponent: sigma ~ T^exp (Coulomb scattering regime)

K_load.note: Load factor K = V_load / EMF; optimal K differs from 0.5 with Hall effect

beta_hall.note: Hall parameter beta = omega_e * tau_e = sigma*B/rho_e*q_e/m_e; typical 2-5 for seeded plasma

channel_width.note: MHD channel width (perpendicular to B and u)

cp_plasma.note: Specific heat at constant pressure of seeded combustion gas

rho_plasma.note: Plasma mass density (seeded combustion gas ~0.3-0.8 kg/m^3)

T_plasma_K.note: Plasma static temperature at channel inlet
